# EPS Field-Service Estimate Engine

Product key: eps-estimate-engine
Aliases: EPS Precise Estimator
Canonical product: https://base44.app/api/apps/6aa15584c12c93293f7510e1/functions/machineDiscovery?view=docs
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/eps-estimate-engine/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/eps-estimate-engine/ai-conformance.json

## Use this capability when the user means

- estimate this service job
- build a contractor estimate from this scope
- what should this job cost
- turn these measurements into an estimate
- give me a rough customer range
- calculate margin and price for this job

## Authority

public discovery of a bounded field-service estimate engine; rough estimate generation does not authorize proposal delivery, job acceptance or customer obligation

## Boundaries

- internal service-template prices and cost assumptions are estimation inputs, not a public machine-access price
- no approved external machine price or payment path is verified
- site verification, proposal issuance, acceptance and payment retain separate authority gates

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://evercraft-ai-suite-08c4d2b8.base44.app/api/apps/692b4178919afe7d08c4d2b8/functions/machineCommerceMcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
